name: Naked Rice Organic Sprouted Brown Rice Protein Powder
whyItWorks: Single-ingredient sprouted brown rice protein. Extremely hypoallergenic, vegan, dairy-free, and avoids the heavy oligosaccharide fermentation and gas caused by raw pea or soy powders.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Blend with soft banana and water. Rice protein can have a slight natural graininess; blending thoroughly yields best mouthfeel.
